title: Onboard a new customer
summary: After an approved customer agreement or subscription is ready for implementation. A verified first-value outcome and an accepted handover to ongoing support and account ownership.
outcomes: A verified first-value outcome and an accepted handover to ongoing support and account ownership.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: After an approved customer agreement or subscription is ready for implementation.

parts.title: Reconcile the sales-to-delivery handoff
parts.guidance: Collect the signed scope, customer sponsor, intended users, promised outcomes, billing terms and implementation constraints. Resolve unsupported promises before treating the handoff as an approved delivery plan.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Agree the implementation plan
parts.guidance: The customer and delivery owner confirm milestones, responsibilities, data access, training and acceptance criteria. Route additional scope or sensitive integrations through their approval processes.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Configure approved access and implementation settings
parts.guidance: Authorized operators provision the contracted features and least-privilege roles. Test imports or integrations in an appropriate environment and retain evidence of any required customer authorization.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Configure approved access and implementation settings

parts.title: Guide users to the first agreed outcome
parts.guidance: Deliver the agreed training and supervised workflow with the customer. Record actual task completion and user feedback rather than marking onboarding complete because an invitation was sent.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Guide users to the first agreed outcome

parts.title: Verify acceptance and transfer ongoing ownership
parts.guidance: Confirm the agreed outcome, unresolved actions, support contacts and billing readiness. Record the customer acceptance or exception and assign the owner of adoption, renewal and future requests.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A verified first-value outcome and an accepted handover to ongoing support and account ownership.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
